# Pencil Agent

> An open-source experiment from Really Good Work Inc. Sometimes it's easier to point than to explain. Draw on a live website with an Apple Pencil (iPad) or a finger (phone), say or type what you want, and Claude Code makes the change on your Mac. The page reloads with the fix. Free, MIT licensed.

## Why

Most visual problems show up when you look at the real site on an iPad or phone. The fix is usually small, but making it meant opening the laptop, finding the file and writing out what you meant. Pencil Agent lets you point at the thing instead.

## How it works

1. Circle the thing. Apple Pencil on an iPad, or a finger on a phone.
2. Say what you want, or type it, e.g. "Make this our brand orange."
3. Your Mac gets the note, with the element and the file it lives in (about 60 tokens per note).
4. Claude Code makes the change. The page reloads and the note turns green.

- Finding the element: it asks the browser what's under your circle and picks the element the circle mostly covers (it steps out to the parent while the circle still covers 70% of it).
- Marks: circle (this one), arrow (move it here), box (add something here; write inside it to say what), X or strike-through (remove it), underline (make it stand out). Strokes are measured, not matched to pictures. It shows how it read your marks before you send.
- Voice: keyboard dictation, or whisper.cpp running on the Mac. No paid transcription.
- Modes: headless (`claude -p`), relay (a live Claude Code session claims notes), and MCP.
- Format: Agentation Annotation Format Schema (AFS) v1.1.

## Requirements

- A Mac with Node.js 20.6+, Claude Code signed in, and your app's dev server.
- An iPad or iPhone. Tailscale (free) connects them from any network and gives HTTPS for the mic. Same Wi-Fi works without it.

## Security

- The server binds 127.0.0.1, rejects unknown Host headers, and checks a token and the app's exact origin on every request.
- The agent may only read, search, edit and write files. No terminal, no internet.
- Notes, sketches and voice stay on the Mac. Development only; never injected into production builds.

## Try it

```
git clone https://github.com/reallygoodwork/pencil
cd pencil
npm run demo
```
